sentences.text: [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/types|src/types]] is a TypeScript area of seven source files, one of them tested, holding the shared types of the desktop app.

It is used by [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/components|src/components]] 41 times, mostly for [[#/repo/reggie/file/src/types/terminal.ts|terminal.ts]] (21), and by [[#/repo/reggie/area/src/hooks|src/hooks]] 12 times; it imports nothing from the rest of the repo.
Nobody has written a note on it; the only note that applies is the repo note by [[#/repo/reggie/person/jacobpress|jacobpress]].
No task plans to touch it; it changed twice in the last 30 days, last by [[#/repo/reggie/person/jacobpress|jacobpress]] on 4 Sep.
